key_claims.claim: International Delphi consensus establishes the first structured clinical guidelines for diagnosis, monitoring, and management of primary fetal pleural effusion
Non-RhD alloimmunizations require antibody-specific approaches to titration thresholds, genotyping accuracy, and intervention timing rather than extrapolation from RhD protocols
Most systematic reviews on prenatal Down syndrome screening are low quality, but NIPT superiority over traditional screening remains robust across sensitivity analyses
Mirror syndrome shares an angiogenic biomarker profile with preeclampsia, and treating underlying fetal hydrops via in utero therapy can reverse maternal disease

In 52 TAPS cases, treatment choice correlated with gestational age, MCA discordance, and fluid status; selective fetoscopic laser had lowest dual survival at 50% but achieved latest delivery gestation
